video_title: Arguing if Embiid is still the BEST player on the 76ers and if it's still HIS team 👀

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if the 76ers got better or worse after trades
quotes.excerpt: Does this trade propel Philly into the best team in the East?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Did the 76ers get worse? They will be a five or six seed.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: They are a top six.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I will go on a limb and say they might be one.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I say four. Does this trade propel Philly into the best team in the East? They now have Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown, and Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Questioning if LeBron James will leave the Lakers for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: You are waiting to see what 42-year-old LeBron James is going to do.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Are you waiting to see what 42-year-old LeBron James is going to do?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Yes. Will LeBron James go to the 76ers?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Suggesting the 76ers need another big man to support Embiid
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is not going to be healthy all year, so you need somebody else.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Trade Tyrese Maxey for Domantas Sabonis. Go get you another big man. You do not have another big man. Joel Embiid is not going to be healthy all year, so you need somebody else.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Guys, we do not have money. How the fuck are we going to pay Domantas Sabonis?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Discussing Andre Drummond's future and potential pay cuts
quotes.excerpt: Andre Drummond is not coming back for sure to the 76ers.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Andre Drummond is not coming back for sure to the 76ers. He said he is not taking a pay cut.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I am going to tell you something, he is taking a pay cut.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating who is the best player on the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I have done more than all y'all. I can get us the MVP of the Finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I have done more than all y'all. I am an MVP of the Finals. I can get us there and the gold medal.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Joel Embiid is the MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: My guy, I am an MVP of the Finals. I can get us there and the gold medal.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Arguing the 76ers are not better than Boston without Embiid
quotes.excerpt: They do not beat Boston if Joel Embiid is not on that team.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They do not beat Boston if Joel Embiid is not on that team.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I agree. Stop with the 'if healthy' shit. He is not going to be healthy.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey as top players
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey, you are Kyrie Irving. What the fuck is wrong with that?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Tyrese Maxey, yes, you are very pivotal. Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey, you are Kyrie Irving. What the fuck is wrong with that? They are both one As.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Do you think Tyrese Maxey can be a one A?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Jaylen Brown's status as a top 10 player
quotes.excerpt: Do we all agree that Jaylen Brown was a top 10 player this year?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do we all agree that Jaylen Brown was a top 10 player this year?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I think Tyrese Maxey was probably right there.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Discussing Dwyane Wade and LeBron James' legacy
quotes.excerpt: Dwyane Wade, LeBron James, Chris Bosh. Whose team was it?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Dwyane Wade, LeBron James, Chris Bosh. Whose team was it?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Dwyane Wade. But who is the better player? LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Steph Curry and Dwyane Wade won championships before stars arrived
quotes.excerpt: Did they win championships before those guys got there?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You use Steph Curry and Dwyane Wade. Did they win championships before those guys got there?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That is the difference. Did they win championships before they got there?
